messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: redis-prod shard-3 — clients=10240 (maxclients=10000), evictions rising, latency P95 > 120ms. Auto-page -> #eng-oncall

pagerduty-bot: PD: pager fired (INC-8241) -> eng-oncall primary: alex.garcia. If unacked in 3m will escalate.

alex.garcia: acked. looking. pulling metrics now.

alex.garcia: quick glance — redis-ops dashboard shows accept-queue length spiking, maxclients reached on 3/6 replicas, primaries showing eviction_rate up 300%.

maria.kim: on standby, grabbing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-high-clients

alex.garcia: running `redis-cli -h shard3.prod --csv INFO clients` -> `connected_clients:10240, blocked_clients:0`

alex.garcia: logs:
```
[2024-06-15T18:12:03Z] WARNING Client limit reached. rejecting new connections
[2024-06-15T18:12:09Z] INFO Evicted 128 keys due to memory pressure
```

sam: any customer-facing impact? seeing higher 5xx on API gateway?

support-bot: Alert from monitoring -> api-gateway: 5xx rate increased from 0.2% -> 3.8% in last 5m, correlated with redis latency spikes. Top affected endpoints: /search, /chat/generate.

maria.kim: likely downstream cache misses causing DB pressure too, need quick mitigation to reduce evictions and accept queue. Options: bump maxclients, add ephemeral connection proxy, or failover heavy-traffic shard.

alex.garcia: can we scale read-replicas (redis) in prod-region-1? autoscaler is capped for shards, manual spin-up takes ~2m.

sam: if we bump `maxclients` ephemeral, risk OOM. what's current memory headroom?

alex.garcia: memory used ~78% on primaries, some replicas at 85%. small headroom. bumping maxclients might backfire. prefer traffic-shedding + proxy.

maria.kim: immediate step: enable `client-output-buffer-limit` stricter for non-critical clients and flip gateway rate-limits for chat/search to 30rps per key to reduce new connections. Also route read-heavy requests to warm cache region.

alex.garcia: executing temporary config via config-service: `PATCH /api/v1/redis/shard3/config -> set client-output-buffer-limit for pubsub to 256mb` (applied).

sam: applying API gateway throttles to /search and /chat/generate -> set burst 50, rate 20r/s for anonymous keys.

incident-bot: System note: PD escalation timer bumped, still acknowledged by alex.garcia.

maria.kim: also starting rolling restart of one replica to drain and rejoin (to clear accept-queue). Doing replica-2 first.

alex.garcia: results from `redis-cli INFO replication` -> replica-2 sync in progress, replication backlog ok. If restart succeeds, expect client acceptance to improve.

sam: monitoring metrics: accept-queue length dropped ~40% after throttle, p95 redis latency down to 70ms from 120ms. API 5xx trending down to 1.1%.

maria.kim: good. keep throttles for 10m, plan for medium-term: add a connection-proxy pool (pgbouncer-like) in front of redis, or pre-warm additional replicas for shard-3.

alex.garcia: adding temporary proxy workers: `k scale deploy/redis-proxy --replicas=3 -n prod` -> pods coming up.

support-bot: Customer impact note prepared: "Some users experienced increased latency and transient errors on search and chat features between 18:10-18:26 UTC. Mitigations applied; monitoring indicates recovery. Incident ticket INC-8241 created."

maria.kim: handing off to next on-call for long tail: @sam take end-to-end and follow-up with infra to schedule pre-warm.

sam: ack — I'll own postmortem and schedule scale tests. collecting all logs/graphs.

alex.garcia: passing back to normal ops, leaving throttle for 12m. Will post final summary in ~30m.

pagerduty-bot: PD: incident acknowledged by alex.garcia; no further escalation.

incident-bot: NOTE: runbook steps executed: throttle-api -> applied, restart-replica -> done, deploy-proxy -> in-progress.

maria.kim: quick checklist for postmortem: cause, why autoscaler didn't kick, why accept-queue built up, whether client library leaked connections, and whether we need a stronger pre-warm policy.

sam: adding action items to INC-8241: [1] Increase replica warm capacity for shard-3, [2] Improve monitoring for accept-queue spikes, [3] Eval connection proxy for redis.

alex.garcia: final check: p95 redis latency = 45ms, evictions back to baseline, API 5xx = 0.3%. closing active mitigation.

support-bot: Posting customer impact update to status page draft -> staging for review.

maria.kim: thanks team. handoff complete.

alex.garcia: thanks — filing logs under /incidents/INC-8241/logs and creating timeframe notes.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active mitigation. Any further alerts will reopen the thread.
